statement: Read-only Rust inspection of the hash-pinned captured references finds forty minimal grevlex leading monomials in each of saved cases 0 and 1, with degree histogram 2:6,3:9,4:10,5:9,6:5,7:1. The degree-7 minimal generator is x5^7. Therefore the prior degree-5/6 full-basis templates cannot supply the required minimal degree-7 leading generator; they are inadequate-degree negative controls, not evidence against degree-7 or general compiled templates. No new solve or timing was run for this analysis.
